meta.title: dsh-think-chat
meta.description: One plugin that ships two agent presets: Chat only (offline) and Chat only (online, offline unless you ask it to search). Both accept images, let the model drive its own multi-round thinking (keep_thinking), search files, and read Office documents through a read-only structure manifest (office_outline: pages, pictures per page and type, tables, sections) plus a paragraph-preserving text channel (office_text); office_render from the Office skill shows only the pages that need layout. Neither modifies files nor produces deliverables.
